intro.text: An ethnic group of Sel that settled around Elantris thousands of years before the Reod. Most Arelene and Teos have Aonic ancestry.

description.text: Aonic people mostly look alike, though Teos tend to be taller than the Arelene, and Sarene's light hair stands out where brown hair is usual.
Their skin is lighter than that of the JinDo. The people of Duladel, of mixed Aonic and JinDo descent, fall in between.
The Shaod takes only people with Aonic ancestry, making them Elantrians.
